meaning.en: waters
this was unmanifest, just fluid
Prajapati, lord of creatures
on a lotus leaf
desire arose within his mind
meaning.hi: उसके मन में इच्छा उत्पन्न हुई

meaning.en: let me create this
what a person approaches in mind
meaning.hi: जो पुरुष मन से प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: that he speaks with words
that he does through action
desire arose first, at that beginning
the first seed of mind
the wise found the bond of being within non-being
meaning.hi: ज्ञानियों ने सत् का बन्धु असत् में खोजा

meaning.en: seers found it by searching their own hearts
meaning.hi: कवियों ने हृदय में खोजकर पाया

meaning.en: whatever one desires
he performed austerity
having performed austerity
Bhusunda approached Kalagnirudra
Lord, tell me the greatness of vibhuti
meaning.hi: हे प्रभु, विभूति की महिमा बताइए

meaning.en: he replied, so be it
he spoke the greatness of ash and rudraksha
meaning.hi: उसने भस्म और रुद्राक्ष की महिमा कही

words.sanskrit: adau eva paippaladena saha uktam iti

meaning.en: already spoken earlier with Pippalada
meaning.hi: पहले ही पैप्पलाद के साथ कहा गया

meaning.en: what more should I say beyond that

words.sanskrit: brihajjabala-abhidham mukti-shrutim mama upadesham kurushva iti

meaning.en: teach me the liberation-scripture called Brihajjabala
Om, so be it
from Sadyojata, the earth
its dissolution follows
it has a golden-brown color and blissful nature
meaning.hi: उसका रंग कपिल और स्वभाव आनन्दमय है

meaning.en: from it, ash was born through cow dung
meaning.hi: उससे गोबर द्वारा विभूति उत्पन्न हुई

meaning.en: from Vamadeva, water
from it, stability
dark colored, plain natured
from it, ash born through cow dung
from Aghora, fire
from it, knowledge
red colored, fragrant
from Tatpurusha, wind
from it, peace
white colored, gentle natured
from it, salt-like ash born through cow dung
from Ishana, space
from it, peace beyond peace
many-colored, gentle-minded
from it, protection born through cow dung

words.sanskrit: vibhutih bhasitam bhasma ksharam raksha iti bhasmanah bhavanti pancha namani

meaning.en: vibhuti, bhasita, bhasma, kshara, raksha - five names of ash
meaning.hi: विभूति, भसित, भस्म, क्षार, रक्षा - भस्म के पाँच नाम

meaning.en: called bhuti for causing great glory
meaning.hi: ऐश्वर्य का कारण होने से भूति

meaning.en: called bhasma for consuming all sin
called bhasita for shining
called kshara for washing away calamity
called raksha for protecting from ghosts, spirits, seizures, and worldly fear
meaning.hi: भूत-प्रेत-पिशाच-अपस्मार-भय से रक्षा करने से रक्षा

meaning.en: Bhusunda (the questioner)
Kalagnirudra
made of fire and soma together
the rite of the ash bath
he asked
as a single fire that has entered the world
meaning.hi: जैसे एक अग्नि संसार में प्रविष्ट

meaning.en: takes a matching shape in every form
meaning.hi: प्रत्येक रूप में अनुरूप बन जाती है

meaning.en: one ash, the inner self of all beings
meaning.hi: एक भस्म, सब भूतों की अन्तरात्मा

meaning.en: matching every form, also outwardly
meaning.hi: हर रूप के अनुरूप, बाहर भी

meaning.en: the universe made of fire and soma
thus the wise declare of fire
meaning.hi: ऐसा अग्नि के विषय में कहा जाता है

meaning.en: the fierce, terrifying, fiery body
soma, made of power and nectar
the strength-giving body
that nectar which is the foundation
itself light, knowledge, and art
in gross and subtle beings
that same pair, essence and radiance
radiance has a twofold movement
meaning.hi: तेज की गति दो प्रकार की

meaning.en: one of the sun, one of fire
so too the power of essence
one of the moon, one of fire
radiance made of lightning and the like
essence made of sweetness and the like
through these distinctions of radiance and essence
this moving and unmoving world holds together
meaning.hi: यह चराचर जगत टिका हुआ है

meaning.en: nectar arises from fire
fire grows through nectar
hence the offering is understood so
the world made of fire and soma
soma, carrying the upward force
fire, carrying the downward force
joined by these two, therefore
meaning.hi: इन दोनों के मेल से इसलिए

meaning.en: this world is bound together forever
above fire this current continues
meaning.hi: अग्नि के ऊपर यह धारा चलती है

meaning.en: until it reaches the supreme nectar of soma
meaning.hi: जब तक परम सौम्य अमृत तक

meaning.en: as long as that fire-born nectar exists
it keeps flowing back down
meaning.hi: वह नीचे प्रवाहित होता रहता है

meaning.en: this is exactly why Kalagni
is placed below, its force rising
so that as burning continues above
meaning.hi: जब तक ऊपर दहन चलता रहे

meaning.en: purification keeps happening below
held steady by the foundational power
this Kalagni rises upward
just so, soma flows downward
meaning.hi: वैसे ही सोम नीचे बहता है

meaning.en: the true seat of Shiva and Shakti
Shiva, of the upward nature
Shakti too shares that upward force
thus by Shiva and Shakti together
nothing here is left unpervaded
burned again and again by fire
this world turned entirely to ash
meaning.hi: यह जगत् भस्म कर दिया गया

meaning.en: this, they say, is fire's true potency
meaning.hi: इसे अग्नि की सच्ची शक्ति कहते हैं

meaning.en: that potency which becomes ash
meaning.hi: वह शक्ति जो भस्म बनती है

meaning.en: whoever knows this true nature of ash
and bathes in it
with mantras beginning agni
he is said to have his sins burned away
meaning.hi: उसके पाप जले हुए कहे जाते हैं

meaning.en: ash, which is fire's own potency
meaning.hi: अग्नि की शक्ति रूप वह भस्म

meaning.en: immersed again in soma
without the discipline of yoga, bound to nature
it remains fit only for ordinary law
meaning.hi: साधारण अधिकार के योग्य रहती है

meaning.en: but that ash, through the discipline of yoga
immersed on every side
by Shakti's shower of nectar
moves beyond the reach of karmic law
meaning.hi: अधिकार से परे हो जाती है

meaning.en: thus, for conquering death
this nectar-bath belongs to the wise
in contact with Shiva-Shakti's nectar
once attained, how could death remain
meaning.hi: प्राप्त होने पर मृत्यु कहाँ रहे

meaning.en: whoever knows this deep, hidden truth
meaning.hi: जो इस गहन गुह्य को जानता है

meaning.en: and this purifying teaching
having truly joined fire and soma
is never born again
having burned the body in Shiva's fire
meaning.hi: शिव की अग्नि में शरीर जलाकर

meaning.en: whoever with the nectar of Shakti and soma
bathes it by the path of yoga
he becomes fit for immortality
meaning.hi: वह अमरता के योग्य होता है

meaning.en: fit for immortality indeed, so it is said
meaning.hi: निस्संदेह अमरता के योग्य - ऐसा कहा गया

meaning.en: twisted or deformed in body
wild and unruly
filthy, carrying inauspicious marks
wasted in body, without a calf
restless, giving no milk when milked
lacking vitality, fed only dry grass
one that gnaws hair, cloth, or bone
pregnant, newly delivered, or sick - such a cow is to be left aside
meaning.hi: गर्भवती, नवप्रसूत, या रोगग्रस्त गाय को छोड़ देना चाहिए

meaning.en: one should gather wholesome dung
dung from a healthy cow is to be taken
meaning.hi: स्वस्थ गाय का गोबर ग्रहण करने योग्य

meaning.en: from a clean place, not that fallen on unclean ground
meaning.hi: शुभ स्थान का, अपवित्र भूमि पर गिरा त्याज्य

meaning.en: the upper portion should be worked with the cow's own milk
meaning.hi: ऊपरी भाग को गव्य से गूँधे

meaning.en: reddish-brown or white

words.sanskrit: alabhe tat anya gauh syat doshavarjita

meaning.en: failing that, any other flawless cow will do
meaning.hi: न मिलने पर कोई और दोषरहित गाय हो

meaning.en: ash of the reddish-brown cow's dung, if obtained, is prescribed
meaning.hi: कपिला गाय की भस्म प्राप्त हो तो प्रशस्त

meaning.en: to be worn only after proper preparation
meaning.hi: संस्कार सहित ही धारण करने योग्य

meaning.en: knowledge is the power of all things
meaning.hi: विद्या समस्त वस्तुओं की शक्ति है

meaning.en: it is spoken of as Shakti
knowledge rests on the three gunas
and those gunas rest on that knowledge
meaning.hi: और वे गुण उस विद्या पर आश्रित

meaning.en: these three gunas are the cow
meaning.hi: ये तीन गुण ही गाय हैं

meaning.en: knowledge became her wholesome dung
her urine is said to be the Upanishads
from that one should make the ash
her calf is memory and recollection
and the dung arises from that same source

words.sanskrit: agavah iti mantrena dhenum tatra abhimantrayet

meaning.en: with the agavah mantra, one should address the cow there
meaning.hi: 'आगावः' मंत्र से गाय को सम्बोधित करे

meaning.en: the mantra gavo bhaga gavah
one should offer water as tarpana
having fasted on the fourteenth day
bright or dark fortnight, keeping the vow
meaning.hi: शुक्ल या कृष्ण पक्ष में व्रती

meaning.en: rising early the next day
becoming pure, focused
properly bathed, in washed clothes
and let the cow's milk flow
meaning.hi: और गाय का दूध बहने दे

meaning.en: having raised the cow with care
one should draw her urine with the Gayatri
in a vessel of gold, silver, or copper
meaning.hi: सोने, चाँदी, तांबे के पात्र में

meaning.en: or hold it in a clay pot
meaning.hi: या मिट्टी के घड़े में रखे

meaning.en: or in lotus-wood or palasha-wood vessels
meaning.hi: कमल या पलाश के पात्र में

meaning.en: or even in a cow's horn
the dung, with the gandhadvara mantra
take it without letting it touch the ground
meaning.hi: भूमि को न छूते हुए ग्रहण करे

meaning.en: the wise one should purify the dung
with the mantra shrir me bhajatu
with the mantra alakshmir me
set aside dung mixed with grain husks
with the mantra santva asincham
sprinkle water onto the dung
with the mantra beginning pancanam
fourteen lumps
shape them, purifying with rays
gather them by the sun's own rays
then place them in the vessel mentioned before
following one's own household ritual manual
establish the fire and worship it
the lumps should be placed there
with Om at the beginning and end
of the six-syllabled hymn
and its expanded form, syllable by syllable
meaning.hi: और उसके विस्तृत रूप से अक्षर-अक्षर

meaning.en: offer each, ending with svaha
the lumps offered to the deity of sacred speech
the wise add aghara and ajyabhaga with the vyahritis
meaning.hi: सुधी आघार-आज्यभाग को व्याहृतियों सहित जोड़े

meaning.en: offers twenty-three to the lord of dissolution
meaning.hi: विनाश के स्वामी को तेईस आहुतियाँ

meaning.en: the five Brahmas are to be offered to
with the words namo hiranyabahave
having offered all the oblations
with mantras ending in the fourth case
including rtam satyam, kadrudraya
the wise should offer with these
the three unspoken syllables as well
having also offered with the vyahritis
then the svishtakrit offering should be made
having completed the remainder of the offering
and the vessel full of water

words.sanskrit: purnam asi iti yajusha jalena anyena brimhayet

meaning.en: with the verse purnamasi, enlarge it with other water
meaning.hi: पूर्णमसि यजुष से अन्य जल से बढ़ाए

meaning.en: with amritam brahmaneshu
pour that water on the head
with the signs of the eastern direction and others
scatter the water toward the directions
having given the brahmin a gift
gather a grain sprout for peace
I shall bring this for the protection of all the gods' works
meaning.hi: सब देवों के कर्म की रक्षा हेतु लाऊँगा

meaning.en: you, Jatavedas, this one
I cover with sprouts

words.sanskrit: mantrena anena tam vahnim pulakaih chchadayet tatah

meaning.en: with this mantra, cover the fire with sprouts
meaning.hi: इस मंत्र से अग्नि को अंकुरों से ढके

meaning.en: this covering is remembered as sustaining the flame three days
meaning.hi: यह ढकना तीन दिन लौ बनाए रखने के लिए स्मृत

meaning.en: one should feed brahmins with devotion
meaning.hi: भक्ति से ब्राह्मणों को भोजन कराए

meaning.en: and eat oneself having observed silence
one desiring a larger quantity of ash
should gather more dung

words.sanskrit: dina-trayena yadi va ekasmin divase athava

meaning.en: over three days, or in a single day
meaning.hi: तीन दिन में या एक ही दिन

words.sanskrit: tritiye va chaturthe va pratah snatva sita-ambarah

meaning.en: on the third or fourth day, bathing at dawn in white
meaning.hi: तीसरे या चौथे दिन प्रातः श्वेत वस्त्र स्नान

meaning.en: white sacred thread, white garlands and sandal paste
white teeth, smeared with ash
the mantra-knower with this mantra

words.sanskrit: om tat brahma iti cha uchcharya

meaning.en: having uttered Om tad brahma
release the sprout-covered ash
sixteen rites beginning with invitation there

words.sanskrit: kuryat vyahritibhih tu evam tatah agnim upasamharet

meaning.en: perform with the vyahritis, then gather in the fire
meaning.hi: व्याहृतियों से करे, फिर अग्नि समेटे

meaning.en: with the mantra agnir bhasma
one should take the remaining ash

words.sanskrit: agnih iti adi-mantrena pramrijya cha tatah param

meaning.en: wipe it clean with the mantra beginning agni
meaning.hi: अग्नि आदि मंत्र से स्वच्छ करे

meaning.en: mix with fragrant water or reddish cow's urine
meaning.hi: सुगन्धित जल या कपिला मूत्र से मिलाए

meaning.en: camphor, saffron, kashmira, ushira root, sandalwood

words.sanskrit: agaru-trayam cha eva churnayitva tu sukshmatah

meaning.en: having finely powdered the three agarus

words.sanskrit: kshipet bhasmani tat churnam om iti brahma-mantratah

meaning.en: add that powder into the ash with Om, the Brahman mantra
meaning.hi: ॐ ब्रह्म-मंत्र से चूर्ण भस्म में मिलाए

words.sanskrit: pranavena aharet vidvan brihatah vatakan atha

meaning.en: the knowing one shapes larger pellets with the syllable Om
meaning.hi: विद्वान प्रणव से बड़ी गोलियाँ बनाए

words.sanskrit: anoh aniyan iti hi mantrena cha vichakshanah

meaning.en: and the discerning one, with the mantra anor aniyan

words.sanskrit: ittham bhasma susampadya shushkam adaya mantravit

meaning.en: having thus prepared the ash, the mantra-knower lets it dry
wiping with Om, consecrated with seven Oms
meaning.hi: प्रणव से पोंछकर सात प्रणव से मंत्रित

words.sanskrit: ishana iti shiro-deshe mukham tatpurushena tu

meaning.en: with Ishana on the head, with Tatpurusha on the face
meaning.hi: ईशान से सिर पर, तत्पुरुष से मुख पर

meaning.en: with Aghora on the thighs, with Vamadeva on the private parts
meaning.hi: अघोर से जाँघों पर, वाम से गुह्य पर

words.sanskrit: sadyojatena vai padan sarvangam pranavena tu

meaning.en: with Sadyojata on the feet, the whole body with Om
meaning.hi: सद्योजात से पैर, ॐ से सर्वांग

meaning.en: then dust the whole body from sole to crown
meaning.hi: फिर तलवे से मस्तक तक सर्वांग लेपन

meaning.en: having sipped water, put on washed clothing and hold this
meaning.hi: आचमन कर धुला वस्त्र पहन धारण करे

words.sanskrit: punaracamya karma svam kartum arhasi sattama

meaning.en: sip again and become fit to do one's own duty, excellent one
meaning.hi: पुनः आचमन कर स्वकर्म योग्य बने, हे श्रेष्ठ

meaning.en: ash is fourfold
the first is anukalpa
the second is upakalpa
the third upopakalpa, the fourth akalpa
arising from the agnihotra fire, this is anukalpa

words.sanskrit: vane shushkam shakrit sangrihya kalpoktavidhina kalpitam upakalpam syat

meaning.en: forest dung prepared by the stated method is upakalpa
meaning.hi: वन के सूखे गोबर से विधिवत उपकल्प

meaning.en: forest dung powdered and made into a paste with cow urine
meaning.hi: वन गोबर चूर्ण कर गोमूत्र से लेप

meaning.en: duly prepared, this is upopakalpa
ash at a Shiva temple is akalpa, worth a hundred kalpas
meaning.hi: शिवालय की भस्म अकल्प, सौ कल्पों बराबर

words.sanskrit: ittham chaturvidham bhasma papam nikrintayet mokshan dadati iti bhagavan kalagnirudrah

meaning.en: thus the four kinds of ash cut sin and grant liberation, says Kalagnirudra
meaning.hi: चारों भस्म पाप काटें, मोक्ष दें - कालाग्निरुद्र

meaning.en: explain the rite of the ash bath, he said
having wiped it with the syllable Om
consecrated with seven Oms through scripture
meaning.hi: सात ॐ से आगम विधि से मंत्रित

meaning.en: with that, one should bind the directions

words.sanskrit: punarapi tena astra-mantrena angani murdha-adin uddhulayet

meaning.en: again with the astra mantra, dust the limbs from the head
meaning.hi: अस्त्र-मंत्र से सिर आदि अंग लेपित करे

words.sanskrit: mala-snanam idam ishana-adyaih panchabhih mantraih tanum kramat dhulayet

meaning.en: this is mala-snana, dusted in order with the five mantras beginning Ishana
meaning.hi: यही मल-स्नान, ईशान आदि पाँच मंत्रों से क्रमशः शरीर लेपित

words.sanskrit: ishana iti shiro-desham mukham tatpurushena tu

meaning.en: Ishana on the head, Tatpurusha on the face
meaning.hi: ईशान से सिर, तत्पुरुष से मुख

meaning.en: Aghora on the thighs, Vamadeva on the private parts
meaning.hi: अघोर से जाँघ, वामदेव से गुह्य

words.sanskrit: sadyojatena vai pado sarvangam pranavena tu

meaning.en: Sadyojata on the feet, the whole body with Om
meaning.hi: सद्योजात से पैर, ॐ से सर्वांग

meaning.en: dusting whole body sole to crown, then sipping water
meaning.hi: तलवे से मस्तक सर्वांग लेप, आचमन

words.sanskrit: vasanam dhautam shvetam pradharayet vidhi-snanam idam

meaning.en: wearing clean white clothing - this is vidhi-snana
meaning.hi: स्वच्छ श्वेत वस्त्र धारण - यही विधि-स्नान

meaning.en: on this, there are verses
taking a handful of ash consecrated with the mantra
from head to feet, this was described as mala-snana
meaning.hi: सिर से पैर तक, पूर्वोक्त मल-स्नान

meaning.en: this rite is done reciting the mantra itself; perform vidhi-snana likewise
meaning.hi: उसी मंत्र से यह कर्म, विधि-स्नान भी वैसे करे

words.sanskrit: ishane panchadha bhasma vikiret murdhni yatratah

meaning.en: with Ishana, scatter ash five times on the head, by place
meaning.hi: ईशान से सिर पर पाँच बार भस्म बिखेरे

meaning.en: on the face with the fourth face, on the heart with Aghora eight times
meaning.hi: मुख पर चतुर्थ मुख से, हृदय पर अघोर से आठ बार

meaning.en: with Vamadeva on the private parts, by the thirty deities' distinct places
meaning.hi: वाम से गुह्य पर, त्रिदश-स्थान भेद से

meaning.en: with the ashtavantena sadhyena mantra, dust both feet accordingly
meaning.hi: अष्टावन्तेन साध्येन से दोनों पैर लेपित

meaning.en: the whole body should be dusted properly, as for a king
meaning.hi: राजा के लिए विधिवत सर्वांग-लेपन करे

words.sanskrit: mukham vina cha tat sarvam uddhulya kramayogatah

meaning.en: everything except the face, dusted in sequence
meaning.hi: मुख को छोड़कर सब क्रमशः लेपित

meaning.en: at both twilights, at midnight, and day's start and end
meaning.hi: दोनों संध्या, मध्यरात्रि, दिन के आदि-अन्त में

words.sanskrit: suptva bhuktva payah pitva kritva cha avashyaka-adikam

meaning.en: after sleeping, eating, drinking milk, bodily necessities
meaning.hi: सोने, खाने, दूध पीने, शारीरिक क्रिया के बाद

meaning.en: a woman, eunuch, vulture, cat, crane, mouse
meaning.hi: स्त्री, नपुंसक, गिद्ध, बिल्ली, बगुला, चूहा

meaning.en: having touched such others, perform the ash bath
near a god, fire, teacher, elder, upon such a sight
meaning.hi: देव, अग्नि, गुरु, वृद्ध के समीप

words.sanskrit: ashuddha-bhutale marge kuryat na uddhulanam vrati

meaning.en: the vow-keeper should not dust on unclean ground or a path
meaning.hi: व्रती अशुद्ध भूमि-मार्ग पर लेपन न करे

meaning.en: ash may be mixed with conch-water, with mula grass
meaning.hi: शंख-जल, मूल से भस्म मिश्रण हो

meaning.en: combined with sandalwood, water mixed with ash

words.sanskrit: chandanena samalimped jnanadam churnam eva tat

meaning.en: smeared with sandalwood, that powder grants knowledge
meaning.hi: चन्दन से लेपित वह चूर्ण ज्ञानद

words.sanskrit: madhyahnat prak jalaih yuktam toyam tat anu varjayet

meaning.en: before midday, water mixed with ash; set aside afterward
meaning.hi: मध्याह्न से पहले भस्म-जल, बाद में त्याज्य

words.sanskrit: atha bhusundo bhagavantam kalagni-rudram tripundra-vidhim paprachchha

meaning.en: Bhusunda asked Kalagnirudra about the tripundra rite
meaning.hi: भुसुण्ड ने कालाग्निरुद्र से त्रिपुण्ड्र-विधि पूछी

meaning.en: form the tripundra, embodying Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva
taking it up with three middle fingers, by the root mantra
meaning.hi: तीन मध्यमा उँगलियों से मूल-मंत्र से

meaning.en: or with ring finger, middle finger, thumb, the tripundra may be formed

words.sanskrit: uddhulayet mukham viprah kshatriyah tat shiro-dinam

meaning.en: a brahmin dusts the face, a kshatriya the head
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण मुख, क्षत्रिय सिर लेपित करे

words.sanskrit: dvatrimsha-sthanake cha ardham shodasha-sthanake api va

meaning.en: half across thirty-two places, or across sixteen
meaning.hi: बत्तीस स्थानों में आधा, या सोलह में

words.sanskrit: ashta-sthane tatha chaiva pancha-sthane api yojayet

meaning.en: at eight locations, and likewise at five
meaning.hi: आठ स्थानों में, और पाँच में भी

words.sanskrit: uttamange lalate cha karnayoh netrayoh tatha

meaning.en: on the highest part, forehead, ears, eyes

words.sanskrit: nasa-vakre gale chaiva amsa-dvayam atah param

meaning.en: bridge of the nose, throat, both shoulders

words.sanskrit: kurpare mani-bandhe cha hridaye parshvayoh dvayoh

meaning.en: elbows, wrists, heart, both sides
navel, both private regions, thighs, hips, knees
with the name-mantra of each, the wise should apply the tripundra
meaning.hi: इनके नाम-मंत्र से विद्वान त्रिपुण्ड्र धारण करे

meaning.en: mark it, with focus, across sixteen places
meaning.hi: समाहित होकर सोलह स्थानों में त्रिपुण्ड्र करे

words.sanskrit: shirshake cha lalate cha karne kanthe amsaka-dvaye

meaning.en: head, forehead, ears, throat, both shoulders
meaning.hi: सिर, माथा, कान, गला, दोनों कन्धे

meaning.en: elbows, wrists, heart, both sides of the navel
one mark also on the back
recite the presiding deities there
meaning.hi: वहाँ अधिष्ठाता देवताओं का जाप करे

words.sanskrit: shivam shaktim cha sadakhyam isham vidyakhyam eva cha

meaning.en: Shiva, Shakti, Sadakhya, Isha, and Vidya
and the nine energies beginning Vama - sixteen deities
meaning.hi: वाम आदि नौ शक्तियाँ - सोलह देवता

words.sanskrit: nasatyo dasrakah chaiva ashvinau dvau samiritau

meaning.en: Nasatya and Dasra, together the two Ashvins

words.sanskrit: athava murdhni alike cha karnayoh shvasane tatha

meaning.en: or on the crown, forehead, ears, breathing passages

words.sanskrit: bahu-dvaye cha hridaye nabhya-urvoh yuge tatha

meaning.en: both arms, heart, navel, and both thighs
meaning.hi: दोनों भुजा, हृदय, नाभि, दोनों जाँघ

words.sanskrit: janu-dvaye cha padayoh prishtha-bhage cha shodasha

meaning.en: both knees, feet, and the back - sixteen

words.sanskrit: shivah cha indrah cha rudra-arkau vighnesho vishnuh eva cha

meaning.en: Shiva, Indra, Rudra, Surya, Ganesha, Vishnu
meaning.hi: शिव, इन्द्र, रुद्र, सूर्य, गणेश, विष्णु

words.sanskrit: shrih chaiva hridayeshah cha tatha nabhau prajapatih

meaning.en: Shri, the lord of the heart, Prajapati at the navel

words.sanskrit: nagah cha naga-kanyah cha ubhe cha rishi-kanyake

meaning.en: serpent deities and maidens, two sages' daughters

words.sanskrit: padayoh cha samudrah cha tirthah prishthe api cha sthitah

meaning.en: oceans at the feet, tirthas placed at the back too
meaning.hi: पैरों पर समुद्र, पीठ पर तीर्थ

words.sanskrit: evam va shodasha-sthanam ashta-sthanam atha uchyate

meaning.en: thus the sixteen locations, or the eight, are spoken of
meaning.hi: इस तरह सोलह स्थान, या आठ, कहे जाते हैं

meaning.en: the teacher's seat is the forehead, then both ears

words.sanskrit: bahu-yugmam cha hridayam nabhih iti ashtamam bhavet

meaning.en: the pair of arms, the heart, the navel as the eighth

words.sanskrit: brahma cha rishayah sapta devatah cha prakirtitah

meaning.en: Brahma and the seven sages named as deities
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा और सात ऋषि देवता कहे गए

words.sanskrit: athava mastakam bahu hridayam nabhih eva cha

meaning.en: or alternatively, head, arms, heart, and navel
meaning.hi: या वैकल्पिक रूप से सिर, भुजा, हृदय, नाभि

meaning.en: those who know ash's true nature declared these five locations
meaning.hi: भस्म-तत्त्व के ज्ञाताओं ने पाँच स्थान कहे

meaning.en: apply as circumstance allows, considering place and time

words.sanskrit: uddhulane api ashaktah chet tripundra-adini karayet

meaning.en: if even dusting is impossible, apply the tripundra alone
meaning.hi: लेपन असमर्थ हो तो त्रिपुण्ड्र मात्र करे

words.sanskrit: lalate hridaye nabhau gale cha mani-bandhayoh

meaning.en: at the forehead, heart, navel, throat, and both wrists
meaning.hi: माथा, हृदय, नाभि, गला, कलाई पर

words.sanskrit: bahu-madhye bahu-mule prishthe chaiva cha shirshake

meaning.en: middle of arm, base of arm, back, and head

words.sanskrit: lalate brahmane namah, hridaye havya-vahanaya namah

meaning.en: at forehead, salutation to Brahma; at heart, to the oblation-carrier
meaning.hi: माथे पर ब्रह्मा को, हृदय पर हव्यवाहन को नमः

words.sanskrit: nabhau skandaya namah, gale vishnave namah, madhye prabhanjanaya namah

meaning.en: at navel to Skanda, at throat to Vishnu, at middle to the scatterer
meaning.hi: नाभि पर स्कन्द, गले पर विष्णु, मध्य में प्रभञ्जन को नमः

words.sanskrit: mani-bandhe vasubhyah namah, prishthe haraye namah, kukudi shambhave namah, shirasi paramatmane namah

meaning.en: at wrist to the Vasus, at back to Hari, at shoulder-blade to Shambhu, at head to the supreme self
meaning.hi: कलाई पर वसु, पीठ पर हरि, कन्धे पर शम्भु, सिर पर परमात्मा को नमः

meaning.en: remember him as three-eyed, ground of the three gunas, father of the three

words.sanskrit: smaran namah shivaya iti lalate tat tripundrakam

meaning.en: remembering, apply the tripundra at the forehead saying namah shivaya
meaning.hi: नमः शिवाय कहते माथे पर त्रिपुण्ड्रक

words.sanskrit: kurpara-adhah pitribhyam tu ishanabhyam tatha upari

meaning.en: below the elbow to the two fathers, above to the two forms of Isha
meaning.hi: कोहनी नीचे पितरों को, ऊपर ईशों को

words.sanskrit: ishabhyam nama ityuktva parshvayoh cha tripundrakam

meaning.en: saying salutations to the two Ishas, apply the tripundra at both sides
meaning.hi: ईशाभ्यां नमः कहते पार्श्वों पर त्रिपुण्ड्रक

words.sanskrit: svacchabhyam nama ityuktva dharayet tat prakoshthayoh

meaning.en: saying salutations to the pure ones, apply at both forearms

words.sanskrit: bhimaya iti tatha prishthe shivaya iti cha parshvayoh

meaning.en: bhimaya on the back, shivaya on both sides
meaning.hi: पीठ पर भीमाय, पार्श्वों पर शिवाय

meaning.en: scatter on the head saying salutations to Nilakantha, self of all
meaning.hi: सिर पर नीलकण्ठ, सर्वात्मा को नमः

meaning.en: it destroys all sin, even that gathered in other lifetimes

words.sanskrit: kanthopari kritam papam nashtam syat tatra dharanat

meaning.en: sin above the throat is destroyed by wearing the mark there
meaning.hi: गले ऊपर का पाप वहाँ धारण से नष्ट

meaning.en: sin through the ear, including ear-disease, by wearing at the ear
meaning.hi: कान का पाप, रोगादि सहित, कान-धारण से

words.sanskrit: bahvoh bahu-kritam papam vakshahsu manasa kritam

meaning.en: sin of the arms by the arms, mental sin in the chest by the chest
meaning.hi: भुजा-पाप भुजा से, मानसिक पाप वक्ष से

words.sanskrit: nabhyam shishna-kritam papam prishthe guda-kritam tatha

meaning.en: sin through the genitals by the navel, through the anus by the back
meaning.hi: गुप्तांग-पाप नाभि से, गुदा-पाप पीठ से

meaning.en: sin of the sides, embracing another's wife and the like

words.sanskrit: tat bhasma-dharanam kuryat sarvatra eva tripundrakam

meaning.en: wear that ash and tripundra everywhere on the body
embodying Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, and the three sacred fires

words.sanskrit: guna-loka-trayanam cha dharanam tena vai shrutam

meaning.en: and heard as embodying the three gunas and the three worlds
wear ash consecrated with the manastoka mantra
meaning.hi: मानस्तोक मंत्र से मंत्रित भस्म धारण करे

meaning.en: the vertical mark is the sama form, the middle is triyayusha
the triyayusha marks are made at forehead and both arms
meaning.hi: त्रियायुष माथे और दोनों भुजाओं पर

words.sanskrit: nabhau shirasi hrit-parshve brahmanah kshatriyah tatha

meaning.en: at navel, head, heart-side - brahmins and kshatriyas alike
for all three higher classes, arising from the agnihotra fire
meaning.hi: तीनों वर्णों के लिए अग्निहोत्र से उत्पन्न

meaning.en: this is primary for householders, born of the secluded fire
meaning.hi: यह गृहस्थों के लिए मुख्य, विरजानलज

meaning.en: the secluded fire's ash is taught to be worn
arising from domestic fire practice, especially for householders
meaning.hi: औपासन से उत्पन्न, विशेषतः गृहस्थों के लिए

meaning.en: ash from kindling fire is to be worn by the celibate student
for working classes, from a learned brahmin's household or cooking fire
meaning.hi: शूद्रों के लिए श्रोत्रिय-गृह या पचन-अग्नि से

words.sanskrit: anyesham api sarvesham dharyam chaiva anala-udbhavam

meaning.en: for all others too, ash born from fire generally is fitting
meaning.hi: अन्य सभी के लिए अनलोद्भव धार्य

meaning.en: for renunciants it grants knowledge, for forest-dwellers, detachment
meaning.hi: यतियों को ज्ञानद, वनस्थों को विरक्तिद

meaning.en: for those beyond class and life-stage, from cremation-ground fire
for all, temple-kept ash, born of Shiva's fire, of a Shiva-yogi
meaning.hi: सबके लिए देवालय-स्थ भस्म, शिवाग्निज, शिवयोगी की

meaning.en: kept in a Shiva temple, or smeared on the image
or burned and consecrated through mantra
on this, there are these verses

words.sanskrit: tena adhitam shrutam tena tena sarvam anushthitam

meaning.en: by him all is studied, heard, and carried out
meaning.hi: उसके द्वारा सब पढ़ा, सुना, अनुष्ठित

words.sanskrit: yena viprena shirasi tripundram bhasmana dhritam

meaning.en: by whom the ash tripundra is worn on the head
meaning.hi: जिसने सिर पर भस्म-त्रिपुण्ड्र धारण किया

meaning.en: even one who has abandoned all custom and observance

words.sanskrit: sakrit tiryak tripundra-anka-dharanat sah api pujyate

meaning.en: becomes worthy of honor by wearing the tripundra even once, crosswise
meaning.hi: एक बार तिरछा त्रिपुण्ड्र धारण से भी पूज्य

words.sanskrit: ye bhasma-dharanam tyaktva karma kurvanti manavah

meaning.en: those who reject wearing ash while performing rituals
meaning.hi: जो भस्म-धारण त्यागकर कर्म करते हैं

meaning.en: find no release from the cycle across countless births
meaning.hi: उनकी करोड़ों जन्मों में मुक्ति नहीं

meaning.en: for those burdened with great sin from earlier births
a firm aversion to the tripundra dusting arises

words.sanskrit: yesham kopah bhavet brahman lalate bhasma-darshanat

meaning.en: whoever feels anger seeing ash on a brahmin's forehead
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण के माथे भस्म देख जिन्हें क्रोध हो

meaning.en: the wise can infer a mixed origin from that
meaning.hi: विद्वान उनकी मिश्रित उत्पत्ति अनुमानित करें

words.sanskrit: yesham nasti mune shraddha shraute bhasmani sarvada

meaning.en: those who never have faith in scripturally sanctioned ash
meaning.hi: जिन्हें शास्त्रीय भस्म में कभी श्रद्धा नहीं

meaning.en: it is concluded the rites from conception onward were never done for them
meaning.hi: उनके गर्भाधानादि संस्कार नहीं हुए, यह निश्चय

words.sanskrit: ye bhasma-dharinam drishtva narah kurvanti tadanam

meaning.en: those who, seeing one wearing ash, strike them
meaning.hi: भस्मधारी को देख जो प्रहार करें

words.sanskrit: tesham chandalato janma brahman uhyam vipashchita

meaning.en: the wise infer their birth traces to an outcast lineage
those who feel anger at the properly measured wearing of ash
meaning.hi: मापे हुए भस्म-धारण पर जिन्हें क्रोध

words.sanskrit: te maha-patakaih yuktah iti shastrasya nishchayah

meaning.en: are, by scripture's settled conclusion, burdened with grave sin
meaning.hi: वे महापातकयुक्त, यह शास्त्र का निश्चय

words.sanskrit: tripundrakam ye vinindanti nindanti shivam eva te

meaning.en: those who deride the tripundra deride Shiva himself

words.sanskrit: dharayanti cha ye bhaktya dharayanti shivam cha te

meaning.en: those who wear it with devotion honor Shiva himself
meaning.hi: भक्ति से धारण करने वाले शिव को धारण करें

meaning.en: shame on the forehead without ash
shame on the village without a Shiva temple
shame on a life of worshipping other than the true lord
shame on learning that serves what is not sacred
whatever supreme potency belongs to Rudra's fire
that is celebrated as ash
hence at all times, one joined with ash carries that potency
in one grounded in ash, faults burn through contact with its fire
meaning.hi: भस्मनिष्ठ के दोष भस्माग्नि-संगम से जलें

meaning.en: purified through the ash bath, this is remembered as bhasma-nishtha
whole body smeared with ash, tripundra shining bright

words.sanskrit: bhasma-shayi cha purushah bhasma-nishtha iti smritah

meaning.en: and lying down covered in ash - remembered as bhasma-nishtha
meaning.hi: भस्म में लेटा पुरुष भस्मनिष्ठ स्मृत

words.sanskrit: atha bhusundah kalagni-rudram nama-panchakasya mahatmyam bruhi iti hovacha

meaning.en: Bhusunda asked Kalagnirudra to explain the greatness of the five names
meaning.hi: भुसुण्ड ने पाँच नामों की महिमा पूछी

meaning.en: of Dhananjaya, a Vasishtha-lineage brahmin with a hundred wives
meaning.hi: वसिष्ठ-वंशी धनञ्जय ब्राह्मण की सौ पत्नियाँ

words.sanskrit: jyeshtha-bharya-putrah karunah iti nama tasya shuchismita bharya

meaning.en: the eldest wife's son named Karuna, whose wife was Shuchismita

words.sanskrit: asau karunah bhratri-vairam asahamanah bhavani-tata-stham nrisimham agamat

meaning.en: Karuna, unable to bear brother-strife, went to Nrisimha on the Bhavani's bank
meaning.hi: भ्रातृवैर असह्य कर भवानी-तट के नृसिंह गए

words.sanskrit: tatra deva-samipe anyena upayana-artham samarpitam jambira-phalam grihitva ajighrat

meaning.en: near the deity, he took and smelled a citron offered by another
meaning.hi: देवता के समीप दूसरे का चढ़ाया जम्बीर सूँघा

words.sanskrit: tada tatra-sthah ashapan papa makshiko bhava varshanam shatam iti

meaning.en: those present cursed: sinner, become a fly for a hundred years
meaning.hi: वहाँ खड़ों ने शाप दिया, सौ वर्ष मक्खी बनो

words.sanskrit: sah api shapam adaya makshikah san svacheshtitam tasyai nivedya mam rakshati svabharyam avadat

meaning.en: bearing the curse as a fly, he told his wife his story, protect me
meaning.hi: मक्खी बनकर पत्नी को कथा सुनाई, रक्षा करो कहा

words.sanskrit: tada makshikah abhavat tam evam jnatva jnatayah tailamadhye hi amarayan

meaning.en: he became a fly; his kin, recognizing this, killed him in oil
meaning.hi: मक्खी बना, सम्बन्धियों ने पहचानकर तेल में मारा

words.sanskrit: sa mritam patim adaya arundhatim agamat bho shuchismite shokena alam

meaning.en: she took her dead husband to Arundhati - gentle one, grieve no more
meaning.hi: शुचिस्मिता मृत पति ले अरुन्धती के पास गई, शोक न करो

meaning.en: with the mrityunjaya mantra, she applied it to the dead creature
meaning.hi: मृत्युंजय मंत्र से मृत प्राणी पर लगाया

meaning.en: a gentle breeze arose, fanned by Shuchismita
meaning.hi: शुचिस्मिता के पंखे से मन्द वायु उठी

words.sanskrit: udatishthat tada jantuh bhasmanah asya prabhavatah

meaning.en: the creature rose up through the power of that ash
meaning.hi: उस भस्म की शक्ति से प्राणी उठ खड़ा हुआ

words.sanskrit: tatah varsha-shate purne jnatih ekah hi amarayat

meaning.en: then after a full hundred years, one kinsman killed him again
meaning.hi: फिर सौ वर्ष पूर्ण होने पर एक सम्बन्धी ने फिर मारा

words.sanskrit: bhasma eva jivayamasa kashyam pancha tada abhavan

meaning.en: ash alone revived him; five others arose likewise in Kashi
meaning.hi: भस्म ने ही जिलाया, काशी में पाँच अन्य हुए

words.sanskrit: devan api tathabhutan mam api etadrisham pura

meaning.en: even the gods have been so, and I too was thus before
meaning.hi: देव भी ऐसे रहे, मैं भी पहले ऐसा था

words.sanskrit: tasmat tu bhasmanam jantum jivayami tada anaghe

meaning.en: therefore I revive this creature through ash, without sin
meaning.hi: इसलिए भस्म से इस प्राणी को निष्पाप जिलाता हूँ

words.sanskrit: iti evam uktva bhagavan dadhichih samajayata

meaning.en: having said this, the illustrious Dadhichi came into being
meaning.hi: यह कहकर भगवान दधीचि प्रकट हुए

words.sanskrit: svarupam cha tatah gatva svashrama-padam yayau iti

meaning.en: having taken his own form, he went to his hermitage

words.sanskrit: idanim asya bhasmanah sarva-agha-bhakshana-samarthyam vidhatte ity aha

meaning.en: now this speaks of ash's power to consume all sin
meaning.hi: अब भस्म की सर्व-पाप-भक्षण-सामर्थ्य बताता है

words.sanskrit: shri-gautama-vivaha-kale tam ahalyam drishtva sarve devah kamaturah abhavan

meaning.en: at Gautama's wedding, seeing Ahalya, all gods became overcome with desire
meaning.hi: गौतम-विवाह में अहल्या देख देव कामातुर हुए

words.sanskrit: tada nashta-jnanah durvasasam gatva paprichchhuh tat-dosham shamayishyami ity uvacha

meaning.en: losing judgment, they went to Durvasa asking him to remove the fault; he agreed
meaning.hi: विवेक खोकर दुर्वासा से दोष-शमन माँगा, स्वीकृति मिली

words.sanskrit: iti evam uktva durvasa dattavan bhasma cha uttamam

meaning.en: having said this, Durvasa gave the highest ash
meaning.hi: यह कहकर दुर्वासा ने उत्तम भस्म दी

words.sanskrit: jatah mad-vachanat sarve yuyam te adhika-tejasah

meaning.en: by my word, all of you have become of greater radiance
meaning.hi: मेरे वचन से तुम सब अधिक तेजस्वी

meaning.en: bodies dusted in ash consecrated by the shatarudriya

words.sanskrit: nirdhuta-rajasah sarve tat-kshanat cha vayam mune

meaning.en: all of us had our impurity shaken off at that instant, O sage
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, हम सबकी उसी क्षण रज दूर हुई

meaning.en: we know this as a wonder, ash's power of this kind
meaning.hi: हम इसे भस्म की ऐसी शक्ति का आश्चर्य मानते

meaning.en: listen to another power of this ash
meaning.hi: इस भस्म की अन्य शक्ति सुनो

meaning.en: this itself grants knowledge to Hari and Shankara
destroyer of sins like brahmahatya

words.sanskrit: maha-vibhutidam iti shiva-vakshasi sthitam nakhena adaya

meaning.en: granting great glory, taking with the nail what rests on Shiva's chest
meaning.hi: शिव की छाती से नख से लेकर महाविभूतिद

words.sanskrit: pranavena abhimantrya gayatrya pancha-aksharena abhimantrya harih mastaka-gatreshu samarpayet

meaning.en: consecrated with Om, Gayatri, five-syllable mantra, Hari places it on head and body
meaning.hi: ॐ-गायत्री-पञ्चाक्षर से मंत्रित हरि सिर-देह पर रखें

words.sanskrit: tatha hridi dhyayasva iti harim uktva harah sva-hridi dhyatva drishto drishtah iti shivam aha

meaning.en: meditate in heart, Shiva told Hari; Hari meditating said have you seen it
meaning.hi: हृदय में ध्यान करो कहकर हरि ने ध्यान किया, देखा-देखा कहा

words.sanskrit: tato bhasma bhakshaya iti harim aha harah tatah bhakshayishye shivam bhasma snatva aham bhasmana pura

meaning.en: eat the ash, Hari told Shiva; I will eat it, I bathed and ate ash before too
meaning.hi: भस्म खाओ कहा, मैं खाऊँगा, पहले भी भस्म से स्नान किया

meaning.en: asked of Ishvara, reachable by devotion, Achyuta ate the ash
meaning.hi: ईश्वर से पूछ, भक्तिगम्य भस्म अच्युत ने खाई

meaning.en: there was great wonder - a radiance like a reflection
Vasudeva instantly took the color of a pure pearl
meaning.hi: वासुदेव क्षण में शुद्ध मुक्ताफल-वर्ण हुए

meaning.en: from then on, Vasudeva shone with that white brilliance

words.sanskrit: na shakyam bhasmanah jnanam prabhavam te kutah vibho

meaning.en: ash's knowledge is not graspable, how could its power be, O mighty one
meaning.hi: हे विभो भस्म का ज्ञान असम्भव, प्रभाव कैसे

words.sanskrit: namah te astu namah te astu tvam aham sharanam gatah

meaning.en: salutations to you, salutations to you, I have taken refuge in you

words.sanskrit: tvat-pada-yugale shambho bhaktih astu sada mama

meaning.en: may devotion at your two feet, Shambhu, be always mine
meaning.hi: हे शम्भो, तुम्हारे चरणों में सदा भक्ति हो

meaning.en: one accomplished in wearing ash shall become my devotee

words.sanskrit: atah eva esha bhutih bhutikari iti ukta

meaning.en: this is why this bhuti is called bhutikari
meaning.hi: इसीलिए यह भूति भूतिकरी कही गई

words.sanskrit: asya purastat vasavah asan rudrah dakshinatah adityah pashchat vishvedevah uttarato

meaning.en: before it the Vasus, right the Rudras, behind the Adityas, left the Vishvedevas
meaning.hi: आगे वसु, दाएँ रुद्र, पीछे आदित्य, बाएँ विश्वेदेवा

meaning.en: Brahma, Vishnu, Maheshvara, with sun and moon at the sides

words.sanskrit: richo aksharе parame vyoman yasmin deva adhi vishve nishiduh

meaning.en: the gods who sat on the imperishable in the highest heaven, amid the world
meaning.hi: अक्षर-परम व्योम में जहाँ देव विराजे

words.sanskrit: yah tat na veda kim richa karishyati

meaning.en: whoever doesn't know this, what will they achieve with the verse
meaning.hi: जो न जाने, वह श्लोक से क्या करेगा

words.sanskrit: ya it tat viduh te ime samasate

meaning.en: those who know it truly settle into it
meaning.hi: जो जानते हैं वे ही इसमें स्थिर

words.sanskrit: ya etat brihajjabalam sarva-kamikam moksha-dvaram rin-mayam yajur-mayam sama-mayam brahma-mayam amrita-mayam bhavati

meaning.en: who knows this Brihajjabala, wish-fulfiller, gateway to liberation, made of the three Vedas, Brahman, and immortality
meaning.hi: यह बृहज्जाबाल जानने वाला सर्वकामिक, मोक्षद्वार, त्रयीमय, ब्रह्ममय, अमृतमय

words.sanskrit: ya etat brihajjabalam balo va veda sah mahan bhavati

meaning.en: even a child who knows this Brihajjabala becomes great
meaning.hi: बालक भी जानकर महान बनता है

words.sanskrit: sah guruh sarvesham mantranam upadeshta bhavati

meaning.en: he becomes the teacher qualified in every mantra
meaning.hi: वह सब मंत्रों का उपदेष्टा बनता है

words.sanskrit: mrityu-tarakam gurunа labdham kanthe bahau shikhayam va badhniyat

meaning.en: the death-crossing thread from the guru, tied at throat, arm, or hair
meaning.hi: गुरु से प्राप्त मृत्युतारक गले-बाँह-शिखा में बाँधे

meaning.en: the seven-continent earth isn't sufficient as payment

words.sanskrit: tasmat shraddhaya yam kanchid gam dadyat sa dakshina bhavati

meaning.en: whatever gift given with faith becomes sufficient payment
meaning.hi: श्रद्धा से दिया कोई भी उपहार दक्षिणा बने

words.sanskrit: atha janako vaideho yajnavalkyam upasametya uvacha bhagavan tripundra-vidhim nah bruhi iti

meaning.en: Janaka of Videha approached Yajnavalkya, asked for the tripundra rite
meaning.hi: जनक ने याज्ञवल्क्य से त्रिपुण्ड्र-विधि पूछी

words.sanskrit: sadyojata-adi-pancha-brahma-mantraih parigrihya agnih iti bhasma iti abhimantrya

meaning.en: taking it up with the five Brahma mantras, consecrated with agni and bhasma
meaning.hi: पाँच ब्रह्म-मंत्रों से ग्रहण कर अग्नि-भस्म से मंत्रित

words.sanskrit: manastoka iti samuddhritya triyayusham iti jalena sammrijya

meaning.en: drawn out with manastoka, finished with water using triyayusha
meaning.hi: मानस्तोक से निकाल त्रियायुष से जल से सँवारा

words.sanskrit: tryambakam iti shiro-lalata-vakshah-skandheshu dhritva putah bhavati mokshi bhavati

meaning.en: with tryambaka, worn at head, forehead, chest, shoulders - becomes pure, fit for liberation
meaning.hi: त्र्यम्बकम् से सिर-माथा-वक्ष-कन्धे पर धारण से पूत-मोक्षी

meaning.en: what fruit does one gain from wearing ash
meaning.hi: भस्म-धारण से क्या फल मिलता है

meaning.en: through wearing ash alone, liberation is attained
through wearing ash alone, union with Shiva is gained

words.sanskrit: na sah punaravartate na sah punaravartate

meaning.en: he never returns again, never returns again
meaning.hi: वह फिर नहीं लौटता, फिर नहीं लौटता

words.sanskrit: bhasma-dharanat kim phalam ashnute na va iti

meaning.en: does one gain the fruit of ash-wearing or not
meaning.hi: भस्म-धारण से फल मिलता है या नहीं

meaning.en: the paramahamsas Samvartaka, Aruni, Shvetaketu, Durvasa, Rbhu, and others
meaning.hi: संवर्तक, अरुणि, श्वेतकेतु, दुर्वासा, ऋभु आदि परमहंस

meaning.en: were liberated through ash-wearing devotion alone
what arises from the ash bath
meaning.hi: भस्म-स्नान से क्या उत्पन्न होता है

words.sanskrit: yasya kasyachit sharire yavantah roma-kupah tavanti lingani bhutva tishthanti

meaning.en: in any body, as many pores, that many lingas come to reside
meaning.hi: किसी भी शरीर में रोमकूपों जितने लिंग निवास करें

words.sanskrit: brahmano va kshatriyo va vaishyo va shudro va

meaning.en: whether brahmin, kshatriya, vaishya, or shudra

words.sanskrit: tat bhasma-dharanat etach-chabdasya rupam yasyam tasyam hi eva avatishthate

meaning.en: through wearing that ash, this form of that sacred sound stays established in that body
meaning.hi: उस भस्म-धारण से उस शब्द का रूप उसी में स्थापित रहे

words.sanskrit: janako ha vaidehah pippaladena saha prajapati-lokam jagama

meaning.en: Janaka went with Pippalada to Prajapati's realm
meaning.hi: जनक पैप्पलाद के साथ प्रजापति-लोक गए

words.sanskrit: tam gatva uvacha bho prajapate tripundrasya mahatmyam bruhi iti

meaning.en: having arrived, he asked Prajapati to explain the tripundra's greatness
meaning.hi: प्रजापति से त्रिपुण्ड्र की महिमा पूछी

words.sanskrit: tam prajapatih abravit yathaiva ishvarasya mahatmyam tathaiva tripundrasya iti

meaning.en: Prajapati answered: as great as Ishvara, so great is the tripundra
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने कहा ईश्वर जितना महान त्रिपुण्ड्र उतना ही

meaning.en: Pippalada then went to Vaikuntha

words.sanskrit: tam gatva uvacha bho vishno tripundrasya mahatmyam bruhi iti

meaning.en: arriving there, asked Vishnu to explain the tripundra's greatness
meaning.hi: विष्णु से त्रिपुण्ड्र की महिमा पूछी

words.sanskrit: yathaiva ishvarasya mahatmyam tathaiva tripundrakasya iti vishnuh aha

meaning.en: Vishnu said: as great as Ishvara, so great is the tripundra
meaning.hi: विष्णु ने कहा ईश्वर जितना महान त्रिपुण्ड्रक उतना

words.sanskrit: atha pippaladah kalagni-rudram parisametya uvacha adhihi bhagavan tripundrasya vidhim iti

meaning.en: Pippalada approached Kalagnirudra and asked to be taught the tripundra rite
meaning.hi: पैप्पलाद ने कालाग्निरुद्र से त्रिपुण्ड्र-विधि सिखाने को कहा

words.sanskrit: tripundrasya vidhih maya vaktum na shakyah iti satyam iti hovacha

meaning.en: the tripundra rite cannot by me be spoken - truly, he said
meaning.hi: त्रिपुण्ड्र-विधि मुझसे कही नहीं जा सकती - सत्य, उन्होंने कहा

words.sanskrit: atha bhasma-chchhannah samsarat muchyate bhasma-shayya-shayanah tach-chhabda-gocharah shiva-sayujyam avapnoti na sah punaravartate

meaning.en: covered in ash, freed from worldly existence; sleeping on ash, near that sound, gains union with Shiva, never returns
meaning.hi: भस्म-आच्छन्न संसार से मुक्त, भस्म-शय्या पर सोया शिव-सायुज्य पाकर नहीं लौटता

words.sanskrit: rudradhyayi san amritatvam cha gachchhati sah esha bhasma-jyotih vibhuti-dharanat brahma-ekatvam cha gachchhati

meaning.en: devoted to the Rudra hymns, one attains immortality; this is the light of ash, granting oneness with Brahman
meaning.hi: रुद्राध्यायी अमरता पाए, यह भस्मज्योति ब्रह्म-एकत्व दे

words.sanskrit: vibhuti-dharanat eva sarveshu tirtheshu snato bhavati varanasyam snanena yat phalam avapnoti tat phalam ashnute

meaning.en: through ash-wearing one is bathed in all tirthas, gaining Varanasi's bathing-fruit

words.sanskrit: atha sanatkumarah bhagavantam kalagni-rudram paprachchha adhihi bhagavan rudraksha-dharana-vidhim

meaning.en: Sanatkumara asked Kalagnirudra to teach the rudraksha-wearing rite

words.sanskrit: rudrasya nayanat utpanna rudraksha iti loke khyayante

meaning.en: rudraksha beads are known in the world as arisen from Rudra's eye
meaning.hi: रुद्र के नयन से उत्पन्न रुद्राक्ष कहे जाते

words.sanskrit: sadashivah samhara-kale samharam kritva samhara-aksham mukulikaroti tannayanaj jata rudraksha

meaning.en: at dissolution Sadashiva closes his destructive eye; rudraksha was born from that eye
meaning.hi: संहारकाल में सदाशिव नेत्र मूँदें, उसी से रुद्राक्ष जन्मे

words.sanskrit: dasha-go-pradanena yat phalam avapnoti tat phalam ashnute karena sprishtva dharana-matrena dvi-sahasra-go-pradana-phalam bhavati

meaning.en: words touching rudraksha equal ten cows' fruit; touching and wearing equals two thousand cows
meaning.hi: छूने की वाणी दस गायों का फल, धारण दो हज़ार गायों का

words.sanskrit: tat rudrakshe ekadasha-rudratvam cha gachchhati shirasi dharyamane koti-go-pradana-phalam bhavati

meaning.en: rudraksha grants union with the eleven Rudras; worn on head, equals a crore cows' fruit
meaning.hi: रुद्राक्ष एकादश-रुद्रत्व दे, सिर पर धारण करोड़ गाय-फल

words.sanskrit: etesham sthananam phalam vaktum na shakyam iti hovacha

meaning.en: the fruit of these places cannot be spoken, it was said
meaning.hi: इन स्थानों का फल कहा नहीं जा सकता

words.sanskrit: murdhni chatvarimshat shikhayam ekam trayam va shrotrayoh dvadasha bahvoh shodasha shodasha dvadasha manibandhayoh shat shat angushthayoh

meaning.en: forty at crown, one or three at tuft, twelve at ears, sixteen-sixteen at arms, twelve at wrists, six-six at thumbs
meaning.hi: मुकुट पर चालीस, चोटी एक-तीन, कान बारह, भुजा सोलह-सोलह, कलाई बारह, अँगूठे छह-छह

words.sanskrit: tatah sandhyam sakushah aharahah upasita agnir jyotih iti adibhih agnau juhuyat

meaning.en: then daily twilight rites with kusha grass, offer into fire with agnir jyotih and such mantras
meaning.hi: फिर कुश सहित नित्य संध्या, अग्निर्ज्योतिः से आहुति

words.sanskrit: atha brihajjabalasya phalam no bruhi bhagavan iti

meaning.en: now explain to us the fruit of this Brihajjabala
whoever studies this Brihajjabala regularly

words.sanskrit: sah agni-putah bhavati sah vayu-putah bhavati sah aditya-putah bhavati sah soma-putah bhavati

meaning.en: becomes purified by fire, wind, sun, moon

words.sanskrit: sah brahma-putah bhavati sah vishnu-putah bhavati sah rudra-putah bhavati sah sarva-putah bhavati sah sarva-putah bhavati

meaning.en: becomes purified by Brahma, Vishnu, Rudra, purified in every way
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-रुद्र से, सर्वथा पूत होता है

words.sanskrit: sah agnim stambhayati sah vayum stambhayati sah adityam stambhayati sah somam stambhayati

meaning.en: he masters fire, wind, sun, moon

words.sanskrit: sah udakam stambhayati sah sarvan devan stambhayati

meaning.en: he masters water, all the gods
meaning.hi: जल को, सब देवों को स्तम्भित करे

meaning.en: he masters every planetary influence

words.sanskrit: sah visham stambhayati sah visham stambhayati

meaning.en: he masters poison, masters poison
meaning.hi: विष को स्तम्भित करे, विष को स्तम्भित करे

words.sanskrit: sah mrityum tarati sah papmanam tarati

meaning.en: he crosses beyond death, crosses beyond sin
meaning.hi: मृत्यु से, पाप से पार जाए

words.sanskrit: sah brahma-hatyam tarati sah bhruna-hatyam tarati sah vira-hatyam tarati

meaning.en: crosses beyond killing a brahmin, an unborn child, a hero
meaning.hi: ब्रह्महत्या, भ्रूणहत्या, वीरहत्या से पार जाए

words.sanskrit: sah sarva-hatyam tarati sah samsaram tarati

meaning.en: crosses beyond every killing, the cycle of existence

words.sanskrit: sah sarvam tarati sah sarvam tarati

meaning.en: crosses beyond everything, everything
meaning.hi: सब कुछ से पार जाए, सब कुछ से

words.sanskrit: sah bhurlokam jayati sah bhuvarlokam jayati sah suvarlokam jayati

meaning.en: he conquers the earthly, middle, and heavenly realms

words.sanskrit: sah maharlokam jayati sah tapolokam jayati

meaning.en: conquers the realm of great beings, the realm of austerity

words.sanskrit: sah janolokam jayati sah satyalokam jayati

meaning.en: conquers the realm of the born, the realm of truth
conquers every realm there is

words.sanskrit: sah richah adhite sah yajumshi adhite sah samani adhite sah atharvanam adhite

meaning.en: he studies the Rig, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva Vedas

words.sanskrit: sah angirasam adhite sah shakha adhite sah kalpan adhite

meaning.en: studies the Angirasa texts, the branches, the Kalpa texts

words.sanskrit: sah narashamsih adhite sah puranani adhite

meaning.en: studies the Narashamsi hymns, the Puranas

words.sanskrit: sah brahma-pranavam adhite sah brahma-pranavam adhite

meaning.en: studies the sacred syllable that is Brahman, twice for emphasis
a hundred without the thread ceremony equal one who has it

words.sanskrit: upanita-shatam ekena grihasthena tat samam grihastha-shatam ekena vanaprasthena tat samam

meaning.en: a hundred with the ceremony equal one householder; a hundred householders equal one forest-dweller
meaning.hi: सौ उपनीत एक गृहस्थ, सौ गृहस्थ एक वानप्रस्थ के बराबर

words.sanskrit: vanaprastha-shatam ekena yatina tat samam yatinam tu shatam purnam ekena rudra-japakena tat samam

meaning.en: a hundred forest-dwellers equal one renunciant; a hundred renunciants equal one Rudra-reciter
meaning.hi: सौ वानप्रस्थ एक यति, सौ यति एक रुद्रजापक के बराबर

words.sanskrit: rudra-japaka-shatam ekena atharvashirah-shikha-adhyapakena tat samam atharvashirah-shakha-adhyapaka-shatam ekena brihajjabalopanishad-adhyapakena tat samam

meaning.en: a hundred Rudra-reciters equal one Atharvashiras teacher; a hundred of those equal one Brihajjabala teacher
meaning.hi: सौ रुद्रजापक एक अथर्वशिरस्-शिक्षक, सौ वे एक बृहज्जाबाल-शिक्षक के बराबर

meaning.en: those inspired sages, dwelling in wakeful understanding, kindle it
meaning.hi: वे प्रेरित, जागृत ऋषि उसे प्रज्वलित करते

meaning.en: that highest state belonging to Vishnu
